source: ISO 9001:2026 Quality management systems. Clause references with our own plain-language summaries; the standard's text is copyrighted and not reproduced.
disclaimer: This repository is general information to help you understand and organize work on AI governance frameworks. It is not legal advice and does not guarantee compliance, certification or any regulatory outcome. Requirements are summarized in our own words; always check the official texts and get qualified advice for your situation.

requirements.title: Understanding the organization and its context
requirements.summary: Know the internal and external issues that affect what your QMS can achieve, including whether climate change is relevant.
requirements.evidence: Context register with issues and review date; climate determination with reasons; review at management review.

requirements.title: Needs and expectations of interested parties
requirements.summary: Identify who has a stake in your QMS, what they require, and which of those requirements your QMS addresses.
requirements.evidence: Interested-party register showing requirements and which are addressed through the QMS.

requirements.title: Scope of the QMS
requirements.summary: Decide and write down what the QMS covers: products, services, sites, and any requirement you treat as not applicable, with reasons.
requirements.evidence: Scope statement (documented information) with justification for any non-applicable requirement.

requirements.title: QMS and its processes
requirements.summary: Define the processes the QMS needs, how they connect, who owns them, and how you control and measure them.
requirements.evidence: Process map and process cards; procedures or instructions needed to run processes; records that processes run as planned.

requirements.title: Leadership and commitment
requirements.summary: Top management takes accountability for the QMS and promotes a quality culture and ethical behavior.
requirements.evidence: Management review minutes, culture and ethics statement, concern log, evidence of leaders' involvement.

requirements.title: Customer focus
requirements.summary: Leaders make sure customer and legal requirements are understood and met and customer satisfaction stays a priority.
requirements.evidence: Customer satisfaction results and actions; KPI reviews; complaint handling.

requirements.title: Quality policy
requirements.summary: Set a quality policy that fits your context and strategic direction, communicate it, and make it available.
requirements.evidence: Approved policy (documented information), communication records, availability to interested parties.

requirements.title: Roles, responsibilities and authorities
requirements.summary: Assign and communicate who is responsible for what in the QMS, including keeping the QMS intact during change.
requirements.evidence: Role profiles or RACI tables, organization chart, appointment of responsibilities.

requirements.title: Determining risks and opportunities
requirements.summary: Use your context and interested parties to identify risks and opportunities the QMS must address.
requirements.evidence: Risk and opportunity registers linked to context issues.

requirements.title: Actions to address risks
requirements.summary: Analyze and evaluate risks and take actions proportionate to their impact.
requirements.evidence: Risk register with ratings, actions, owners and effectiveness review.

requirements.title: Actions to address opportunities
requirements.summary: Analyze and evaluate opportunities separately and decide which to pursue.
requirements.evidence: Opportunity register with decisions and results.

requirements.title: Quality objectives
requirements.summary: Set measurable objectives at relevant functions and plan what, who, when and how results are evaluated.
requirements.evidence: Objectives with targets, plans and progress (documented information).

requirements.title: Planning of changes
requirements.summary: Plan changes to the QMS in a controlled way: purpose, consequences, resources, communication, and review of results.
requirements.evidence: Change planning records, communication and post-change review.

requirements.title: Resources, people, infrastructure, environment
requirements.summary: Provide the people, infrastructure and work environment the processes need.
requirements.evidence: Resource plans in management review; maintenance records; work environment provisions.

requirements.title: Monitoring and measuring resources
requirements.summary: Keep measuring equipment suitable, calibrated or verified, identified and protected; act if it is found out of calibration.
requirements.evidence: Calibration register and certificates; basis for calibration where no standard exists; out-of-tolerance assessments.

requirements.title: Organizational knowledge
requirements.summary: Identify the knowledge needed to run processes and achieve results, then retain, apply and share it.
requirements.evidence: Knowledge map, lessons learned, key-person risk actions.

requirements.title: Competence
requirements.summary: Define required competence for each role, close gaps through training or other actions, and evaluate effectiveness.
requirements.evidence: Training matrix, qualifications, training records and effectiveness checks (documented evidence).

requirements.title: Awareness
requirements.summary: Make sure people know the policy, objectives, their contribution, quality culture and ethics, and the consequences of not following the QMS.
requirements.evidence: Awareness session records, quiz results, induction records.

requirements.title: Communication
requirements.summary: Decide what, when, with whom and how to communicate internally and externally about the QMS.
requirements.evidence: Communication plan or matrix; meeting records.

requirements.title: Documented information
requirements.summary: Create, approve, update and control documents and records so the right version is available and protected.
requirements.evidence: Document master list, approval and revision records, retention list, access controls.

requirements.title: Operational planning and control
requirements.summary: Plan and control the processes needed to deliver products and services, including outsourced ones.
requirements.evidence: Control plans, work instructions, records that processes were carried out as planned.

requirements.title: Requirements for products and services
requirements.summary: Communicate with customers (including contingency information), determine requirements, review them before committing, and manage changes.
requirements.evidence: Contract or order review records, records of changed requirements, contingency information given to customers.

requirements.title: Design and development
requirements.summary: Plan and control design: inputs, controls, outputs and changes. Not applicable if you do not design.
requirements.evidence: Design plans, input records, reviews, verification and validation, design change records.

requirements.title: Control of externally provided processes, products and services
requirements.summary: Evaluate, select, monitor and re-evaluate suppliers, and tell them your requirements.
requirements.evidence: Supplier evaluations, approved supplier list, performance monitoring, purchase requirements.

requirements.title: Control of production and service provision
requirements.summary: Run production or service under controlled conditions: information, equipment, competent people, validation where needed.
requirements.evidence: Work instructions, job records, process validation where output cannot be verified.

requirements.title: Identification, traceability, property, preservation, post-delivery
requirements.summary: Identify outputs and their status, trace where required, care for customer property, preserve product and meet post-delivery needs.
requirements.evidence: Traceability records, customer property records, post-delivery activity records.

requirements.title: Control of changes
requirements.summary: Review and control unplanned production or service changes and record the results.
requirements.evidence: Change records with review results, who authorized and actions.

requirements.title: Release of products and services
requirements.summary: Verify requirements are met before release and record who authorized it.
requirements.evidence: Release records with conformity evidence and authorizing person.

requirements.title: Control of nonconforming outputs
requirements.summary: Identify and control nonconforming outputs; correct, segregate, inform or accept under concession.
requirements.evidence: NC records: description, actions, concessions, authority for the decision.

requirements.title: Monitoring, measurement, analysis and evaluation
requirements.summary: Decide what to monitor, how and when, and evaluate QMS performance and effectiveness.
requirements.evidence: KPI dashboard, analysis results (documented evidence).

requirements.title: Customer satisfaction
requirements.summary: Monitor customers' perception of how well their needs are met.
requirements.evidence: Survey results, analysis and actions.

requirements.title: Analysis and evaluation
requirements.summary: Analyze data to evaluate conformity, satisfaction, performance, risk actions, suppliers and improvement needs.
requirements.evidence: Analysis reports feeding management review.

requirements.title: Internal audit
requirements.summary: Run a planned audit program with objectives, criteria and scope; report results and act on findings.
requirements.evidence: Audit program, plans with objectives, reports and findings (documented evidence).

requirements.title: Management review
requirements.summary: Top management reviews the QMS at planned intervals with all required inputs and records decisions.
requirements.evidence: Management review minutes covering all inputs and outputs (documented evidence).

requirements.title: Continual improvement
requirements.summary: Use results, analysis and review outputs to improve the QMS and its results.
requirements.evidence: Improvement projects and their results; opportunity register.

requirements.title: Nonconformity and corrective action
requirements.summary: React to nonconformities, find root causes, act, check effectiveness and update risks if needed.
requirements.evidence: Nonconformity and corrective action records with root cause and effectiveness verification.
